guides.title: Search through your own YouTube comments
guides.subtitle: Privacy-friendly Chrome extension to search comments in your YouTube history.
guides.content:
1. Install YouTube Search Tools.

  2. Go to your YouTube history and click on "Comments".

  3. Click on "Search comments".
